name: Zhong Jia Guo Xin Holdings Company Limited
summary: Asia Resources Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, with its principal operations centered on real estate development and property investments throughout mainland China and Hong Kong. Additionally, the company participates in the manufacturing of bottled mineral water, conducts financial securities trading, and offers management services. The firm was established in 1997, with its main office located in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
